prompts:
Edit the FIRST attached image, the full Bukno desktop mockup, with only the targeted refinements below. The SECOND image is a close-up of the ChatGPT composer and is a visual reference ONLY for its warm neutral surface, close model/effort spacing, compact toolbar hierarchy and rounded shape. Do NOT reproduce the screenshot's typed sentence or add a new screenshot panel. Output ONE full app mockup, 1487 x 1058 pixels, same aspect ratio and three-column layout as the first image.

The user likes the rest of the full-app mockup and wants it preserved: project and chat navigation, right-aligned owning-provider logos on chat rows, right delegated-task list, the precise task names and their summaries, main title, user message, Codex activity text, open uncluttered empty space, absence of any inline preview, small changed-line counts, usage meters and Rasmus profile. Do not redesign these, do not invent content, do not add ornaments or a settings dialog. No preview card, no additional composer, no browser pane.

CHANGE 1: WARM GREY APP SURFACES
Remove the blue/steel/navy undertone from all backgrounds and neutral chrome. Use warm charcoal and warm dark grey, like the second reference. Suggested colors: main canvas #252422, left rail #211F1E, right rail #22211F, composer #302F2D, raised button #3A3936, selected chat #343230. These should feel subtly warm and neutral, never sepia, brown, beige or orange-washed. Main text is warm off-white #F1F0ED, secondary text neutral #B6B3AD. Preserve sky blue #9CCBFF ONLY for Codex indicators, provider labels, usage bar and counts; preserve Claude orange ONLY for Claude identity and meter. Do not spread provider colors across the app's surfaces. Use shading and soft natural shadows for hierarchy. No ornamental outlines, no column divider strokes, no control borders. Matte smooth surfaces, restrained subtle elevation, crisp typography. No bluish vignette, fog, texture, glow across large areas, or glossy gradient.

CHANGE 2: COMPOSER POSITION AND SHAPE
Move the real composer DOWN toward the bottom window edge, so its bottom is only 12 to 14 pixels from the image bottom. In this 1058px-high frame, the composer bottom should be about y=1044. Its left and right edges stay at approximately x=290 and x=1092. Its top should be around y=907, with a 137px height, comfortable multiline area and a compact bottom control row. Rounded corners about 22px, no border, a restrained soft shadow. Keep placeholder exactly "Add a direction while work continues…". Move the small status and aggregate "+100  −5" strip downward with the composer, remaining directly above it. Do not leave the previous large bottom margin.

CHANGE 3: COMPACT COMPOSER MODEL PICKER, FOLLOW THE SECOND REFERENCE
Remove the OpenAI/ChatGPT knot logo from the model-picker control COMPLETELY. There must be NO provider logo anywhere inside the composer.
Use ONE small sky-blue lightning icon as the FIRST element of a tightly grouped unoutlined model selector, then "GPT-6.1 Sol", then a softer and slightly smaller "High", then one tiny downward chevron. Keep gaps within that group about 6px. The lightning sits directly beside the model name, NOT separated between model and effort, and appears only once. Model name and effort should read as a compact continuous inline control just like the close-up reference, with effort typographically quieter. Keep the picker closed, no slider popup.
Rebalance the toolbar into a left cluster and a right cluster: at the far left put the plus icon and then a compact "Ask before changes" permission control with its chevron. At the right, put the tight lightning/model/High/chevron group, followed by the existing Stop action at the far right. A modest gap separates the clusters, with flexible space in the middle. Stop remains available for this running agent. Use a compact warm-grey rounded Stop button with a white square and the word Stop. Align ALL toolbar icons and text on the same optical baseline. Make the controls feel substantially less scattered and more coherent than the first image. Do not add microphone or live-voice controls from the reference; those are not in this mockup's release scope.

CHANGE 4: LEFT FOOTER LOWER DOWN
Move the entire lower-left block DOWN by about 32 to 36 pixels: both Codex/Claude usage labels and thin meters, and the R avatar/name/chevron profile row. The profile row should sit about 12px from the bottom edge, visually aligned with the composer's lower edge. Keep comfortable spacing between its elements and do not clip anything. Labels remain "Codex · 5h · 68% left" and "Claude · 5h · 42% left". Do not introduce additional footer cards, separators or borders.

Preserve all other information and positions. Make a realistic polished native productivity-app screenshot with the warm neutral finish and precise control spacing the user requested. This is a targeted refinement, not a new style direction. The second attachment is a style/spacing reference, not an additional element in the result.

Make a precise minor positional edit to this existing Bukno UI screenshot. Preserve the entire screenshot exactly: warm charcoal grey palette, matte shaded surfaces, soft shadows, all typography, wording, model selector, sidebar, right task list, empty middle space, and every icon. Output the same 1487 x 1058 dimensions. NO redesign or color changes.

Only reduce the bottom gutter:
- Move the entire large bottom-center composer DOWN by about 22 pixels. Its bottom must sit at approximately y=1046, leaving only a very narrow 12px gap to the lower image/window edge. Keep its height, width and left-right placement unchanged. The composer should look visibly anchored close to the bottom window edge, with almost no wasted space beneath it.
- Move the small status/change-count row immediately above the composer down by the same 22 pixels.
- Move the entire bottom-left usage/profile group down by about 10 pixels, so the bottom of the circular R avatar is also only about 12px from the window's lower edge. This includes both usage labels/bars and the profile name/chevron, preserving their internal spacing. Keep every element fully visible.
Everything above these lower controls stays exactly where it is.
Keep the compact composer toolbar exactly as shown: left plus and Ask before changes; right blue lightning directly before GPT-6.1 Sol, quieter High label and chevron, then Stop. No provider logo inside composer.
The narrow bottom margin is the sole purpose of this edit. Do not add a footer, dock, border, panel, preview or any extra content.
